column4: no test may skip in this job: it selects only the linux_arm64 subtest and declares csharp,csharp-arm64, so a missing docker or an arm64 image that cannot run is a failure, and the budget is zero from the first run (cleat#4080, C# PR 7). The amd64 leg is deliberately not run here: probing it fails on this runner with docker "cannot overwrite digest" (#4098), and the x86_64 job verifies that row
